title: Steel roof truss
sentence: A 12 m parallel-chord Pratt roof truss in CHS 88.9 × 5 S355, pinned one end and rollered the other, with 20 kN at each top-chord joint.

expected.reference: unit-load virtual work, δ = Σ N n L / EA over the 21 members

theory: A pin-jointed truss carries load as axial force only, so a statically determinate one is solved by statics alone: the reactions are $R = \frac{1}{2}\sum P = 50\,\mathrm{kN}$, and a vertical cut through any panel gives the diagonal from the shear it has to carry, $N = V/\sin\theta$. Because the truss element is exact in extension, the finite-element member forces are the statics answer to machine precision and the mid-span deflection is exactly the unit-load virtual-work sum $\delta = \sum N n L / EA$. Read member force as `stressUnaveraged`: the averaged nodal field blends the members meeting at a joint and reports a stress no member carries.
